panels.description: Full-page mine-regulator climax. Alex and Bi11bot wrench the manual wheel open together; the wheel and their joined effort form the central silhouette. A broad cold-water surge erupts toward Keel. Alex drops to one knee but keeps one hand on the wheel. Bi11bot anchors against the rail, rounded and protective without menace. The awakened white-and-amber node is a secondary focal point. Leave the upper-left dark and open for GO; reserve the lower water channel for the SFX without covering faces or wheel.
